A whole life comes with you.
Hallelujah General Hospital. Care for your health, with room for the person you are.
Choose a route based on what you already know.
You can begin an appointment request without choosing a doctor or service. Choose “Help me choose”. A request is not a confirmed appointment.
Explore care options and prepare questions for your visit.
Compare selected areas of care before exploring a service in detail.
Explore how a general medicine conversation can begin and which questions may help you prepare for a first visit.
Which concerns should I discuss first?
Which earlier results should I bring?
Find a familiar name, or get to know someone new.
Everyday health concerns and continuity of care.
Questions about a child’s routine care.

What if I need extra support?+
Verified address, entrance, and accessible arrival details will be published here. Please confirm your destination and department before travelling.
Hospital contact details are awaiting verification. A working phone number is not available in this preview.
Online appointment requests are not an emergency channel.
Please confirm credit and insurance arrangements with the hospital before your visit.
Hope in the everyday. Courage in the next step. Stories of finding a way forward.
